---
title: "Tables and files"
description: "Search the BFS tables and download any BFS file."
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

Many statistics are not in the PXWeb API but published as files: Excel or
CSV tables, PX files, PDFs, zip files, ... They are listed in the
[BFS catalog](https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/statistics/catalogue.html)
as article type "Tables". Each file has an asset number, also shown at the
end of the "assetdetail" URLs of the BFS website.

```{r}
library(BFS)
library(dplyr)
```

## Search the tables

`bfs_get_catalog_tables()` has the same arguments as `bfs_get_catalog_data()`
(see [Data catalog and PXWeb datasets](pxweb.html)).

```{r}
tables <- bfs_get_catalog_tables(language = "en", extended_search = "students")
tables
```

## Download a file

```r
asset <- tables |>
  filter(title == "Students at universities and institutes of technology: Basistables") |>
  pull(number_asset)

bfs_download_asset(number_asset = asset, destfile = "students.xlsx")

readxl::read_excel("students.xlsx")
```

`bfs_download_asset()` also takes a BFS number. For a PXWeb dataset too
large for the API, download its PX file and read it with the pxR package:

```r
bfs_download_asset(number_bfs = "px-x-1502040100_131", destfile = "students.px")

students <- pxR::read.px("students.px") |>
  as.data.frame()
```

The PX file is read in German only.

## Metadata of a file

`bfs_get_asset_metadata()` returns the metadata of a file as a nested list:
title, description, publication date, contact, links, ...

```{r}
metadata <- bfs_get_asset_metadata(number_bfs = "px-x-1502040100_131", language = "en")
names(metadata)
metadata$description$titles$main
```
